name: logo/cta-lockup
title: CTA Lockup
title_vi: Khối kêu gọi hành động cuối phim
desc_vi: Dòng kêu gọi trồi lên trước, nút bấm nảy ra bên dưới với một chút vọt, rồi dòng phụ hạ xuống; cả khối trôi nhẹ một nhịp rồi đứng yên.
params_vi: action: dòng kêu gọi · button: chữ trên nút · micro: dòng phụ · accent: màu nút · fg, muted, buttonInk: màu chữ · duration: độ dài gốc 4 s (quyết định độ trôi cuối)
notes: Order, timings, distances and eases as in the source (action 0.5 s power3.out; capsule scale 0.72 -> 1 with back.out(1.7) over 0.6 s plus opacity 0 -> 1 over 0.24 s from 0.56 s (written as set opacity 0 at time 0 + a to tween, same result); microcopy 0.42 s from 1.18 s). All cqw/cqh sizes converted with ctx.W/ctx.H (lockup width min(88cqw,150cqh), action min(10cqw,14cqh), capsule min(4.3cqw,6.8cqh), microcopy min(3cqw,4.2cqh), margins and padding in cqh/cqw). The capsule is a div instead of a button element, and the glow colour-mix(accent 28%) is written as rgba. The source's hold drift (yoyo + repeat 1 over HOLD) is written as two tweens (up then back, sine.inOut), HOLD = duration - 1.6 s with duration the authored 4 s of the source. Accent is a hex param (source: green #22c55e, blue #38bdf8, violet #a78bfa); the fixed capsule text colour #07110d, fg #f8fafc and muted #cbd5e1 are params. Default texts are Vietnamese (source: English). The source compresses IN when the composition is shorter than 1.6 s: not ported. The font is the film's font for all three lines (the source uses two theme font tokens).
